falsification: Reject the change if the target evidence does not improve, cannot be reproduced, or causes a verified regression in another dimension.
hypothesis: A focused reversible test can produce evidence about cognition.
measurement: Compare the target dimension and its raw evidence before and after the test. Do not treat code changes alone as improvement.
method: Supply an evidence-grounded candidate thought and verify invalid evidence references are rejected while a valid falsifiable candidate may influence inquiry without changing evidence.
title: Test grounded generative cognition.
